lines.master: And the egg never fell into the hands of the man in star boots.

lines.rookie: Good luck. Eleanor's friends ask hard questions.
lines.junior: Good luck. Eleanor's friends ask difficult questions.
lines.master: Good luck. Eleanor's friends pose formidable questions.

lines.rookie: Rosa's violin plays the same old tune again.
lines.junior: Rosa's violin plays that same old tune once more.
lines.master: Once again, Rosa's violin drifts into that same old melody.

lines.rookie: That song... where have I heard it?
lines.junior: That song... where have I heard it before?
lines.master: That melody... where have I heard it before?
